name: @tylerbu/tidepool-token-service
description: A Tidepool token mint with Access authentication or opt-in public demo mode

JWT_SECRET.description: **Reuse the exact signing key from core Tidepool.** Paste the JWT_SECRET you supplied during core setup (at least 32 UTF-8 bytes). Tidepool cannot retrieve that key for you. Keep a secure backup.

TENANT_ID.description: Use the same tenant as core Tidepool, normally `fluid`.

TOKEN_AUTH_MODE.description: Defaults to `access`. For a throwaway public demo, choose `anonymous`: anyone can obtain create/read/write/summary tokens for any document in this tenant and incur Cloudflare charges.

ACCESS_AUDIENCE.description: Required in `access` mode: the AUD tag from your Cloudflare Access application. Leave empty only when explicitly using `anonymous` mode.
